title: Route JSON configuration
description: Switch route sources, preview the menu and validate page configuration as JSON.
fallback: API loading failed; using initial routes
staticHint: Use initial JSON routes for offline recovery. Select the server API for the online experience.
localHint: Validate and save the JSON in this browser. Applying changes reloads the page.
remoteHint: Routes are fetched through the API at startup. Saving submits the current JSON and reloads. If loading fails, the initial configuration is used with an error notice.
editHint: Validate to preview the route tree.
contractHint: Give the schema and view catalog to AI or backend developers. API responses, imports and exports use the same format.
fileLimit: JSON files must be at most 256 KiB.
visualDescription: Select a menu item to edit its path, view and access rules.
visualHint: The draft starts from active routes. Saving submits it through the API and reloads the app. The online demo persists it in this browser’s Mock database.
resetConfirm: Discard your draft changes and reload the active configuration?
selectNode: Select a menu item or add one.
deleteConfirm: Delete this item and its children from the draft?
rolesHint: Leave empty to allow all signed-in roles
